SEO.title: github-readme-music | Music Cards for Your GitHub README
SEO.description: Create a personalized music card from a YouTube link for your GitHub README. Customize the design and generate an SVG card with ready-to-use Markdown code.
SEO.imageAlt: github-readme-music — Add your favorite music to your README

Home.heading: Your favorite music,
Home.description: Turn a YouTube link into a music card that shares a little about you in your README.

LocaleSwitcher.label: Select language
LocaleSwitcher.busy: You can change the language once the current operation is complete.

RecentCards.title: Recent cards
RecentCards.description: Select a card to restore its settings and continue editing.

input.hint: Enter a YouTube link to load the title and artist, then customize your card.

content.heading: Content
content.description: Review the information shown on your card and edit it as needed.
content.title: Title
content.artistHint: The artist is initially taken from the upload channel name. Edit it if needed.

cover.title: Album cover
cover.hint: Drag the square frame to reposition it. Drag its bottom-right corner to resize it.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: See how your card will look in your README.

style.title: Title

gradient.label: Accent gradient
gradient.hint: Text may look different in the brighter areas of the selected gradient.

style.contrastWarning: {roles} colors have very low contrast and may be hard to read in your README.

status.refreshingMetadata: Loading new video information. Your current card will stay in place.

Markdown.title: Markdown code
Markdown.readyDescription: Paste the generated code into your GitHub README to display your card.
Markdown.prepareDescription: Generate Markdown for your current settings to use in your GitHub README.
Markdown.pendingChanges: You have unsaved changes. Generate new Markdown to include your current settings.
Markdown.fallbackNotice: The card storage service hasn't responded reliably, so we generated a compatible URL you can use with your current settings. Try generating again later to get a short URL.

copy.label: Copy Markdown
copy.failure: Couldn't copy the code. Select it and copy it manually.

empty.title: You haven't generated Markdown yet.
empty.hint: Finish customizing, then use the button to save your card and generate the code.
